'''Naga Sadow's Fortress Blade''' was a Sith blade created by [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]]. Around [[3622 BBY]], the [[Hidden Chain]] [[Field Marshal/Legends|Field Marshal]] [[Heta Kol]] and [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Jadus]] set up their base on the planet [[Khar Shian]] at [[Naga Sadow's fortress]], where Heta Kol found and utilized it.

==Description==
The ancient blade found in Naga Sadow's fortress had a [[Sword/Legends|sword]] [[Hilt/Legends|hilt]], but the blade itself was jagged and rock-like. It was [[Color/Legends|black]] in color, but when wielded, it would glow in either white, orange or red.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

The blade was cursed, as the sword itself would also tempt people to use it, drawing them near and speaking to them in ancient Sith language. Said usage granted the user multiple supernatural abilities, such as summoning rock formations from the ground, laser beams from the sword, encasing the user in crystal to rest, as well as resonating with the crystals in Naga Sadow's fortress, which caused powerful electrical shockwaves. However, using the weapon came at a cost of grotesquely transforming their bodies. The more powerful strikes were used, the more it drew from the user's life force, glowing reddish. When the user was killed, the glow would be gone.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

==History==
{{Quote|And I will use it, and any weapon, to destroy you--|Heta Kol, wielding the blade|<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />}}
[[File:Heta transformed.png|thumb|right|220px|The effects the weapon has on its user.]]
The blade was lying on a rack of weapons deep inside Naga's Sadow ancient fortress. The Hidden Chain and Darth Jadus' forces stationed themselves there and set up [[Darth Nul]]'s machine. However, they were [[Battle of Khar Shian|attacked]] by the forces of the [[Eternal Alliance]], [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]]. [[Shae Vizsla]], former Mandalore, mocked Heta Kol, the Field Marshal of the Hidden Chain and in a desperate move to assure her victory, Heta spotted the sword as it stared talking to her. Tempted by the promise of power, she took it and approached Shae, the Commander and [[Rass Ordo|Rass]] and [[Jekiah Ordo]]. During their battle, Heta utilized multiple supernatural abilities, courtesy of the sword. 

After they fought, Heta's helm would be knocked off of her head by the Commander, revealing her disfigured grotesque transformed face due to the weapon's influence. As she was about to strike them down, Shae Vizsla shoved Heta into a nearby crystal, shocking her.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" /> However, Heta would draw the sword straight through Shae's stomach, mortally injuring her. With the situation being desperate, Shae shoved herself and Heta into the crystal again, electrocuting Heta, causing her to drop dead on the floor. The sword, still in the Field Marshal's hand, stopped glowing with her last breath.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

==Behind the scenes==
The black Sith blade first appeared simultaneously in the narrative content of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'' and the [[Cartel Market]] (under the name "Naga Sadow's Fortress Blade"), as part of "Game Update 7.9: Legacy Reborn," released on [[June 2]], [[2026]].<ref name="7.9">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20260602-0|text=Game Update 7.9 "Legacy Reborn" is live!}}</ref>
